## Highlights

- Local Envd execution supports native Windows Sandbox launch policies and preserves Windows volume and share roots.
- Computer tools support relative coordinates.

## Upgrade notes

Harness and Stream Protocol are released together at 0.14.0; Stream Protocol requires exactly Harness 0.14.0. Harness now requires `a13n-envd-client>=0.4.0,<0.5.0`. Use the matching daemon release for Envd-backed execution, including custom endpoints and explicit executables.

This release does not update the independent Service compatibility line or require a new Logging release.
